name: NURS 5279
title: Adv Theory & Prct in Nursing Ed III: Learning Principles & Instr Methods for Adult Learner Practicum
description: This course will help students apply important concepts, principles, and practices related to facilitating learning in the adult learner within the context of planning, implementing, and evaluating the effectiveness of an educational offering. Students are expected to synthesize prior coursework in the implementation of the multifaceted nurse educator role in the selected practicum setting. Socialization to and the embodiment of the nurse educator role is explored in the practicum and didactic settings.
requirement_description: NURS 5250, NURS 5259, NURS 5260, NURS 5269. Instructor consent required. Corequisite: NURS 5270.
